bank_proof_review.catalog: For every integer m>=2, all m(m-1) labels (a,b) in {0,...,m-1} x {0,...,m-2} are legal for every player. Each covers the economic singleton e_a and two distinct unit customers in B_b. All coordinate changes, repetitions and simultaneous two-coordinate deviations remain in the action domain.
bank_proof_review.same_strategy_and_history: The complete strategy is a single conditional controller on every ordered history. Every root action, including a deviation, anchors the same BASE rule at its actual pair. Counterfactual continuations always follow that same sigma.
bank_proof_review.exit: A repeated bank has occurred. At depth t at most t-1 banks have appeared, leaving at least m-t fresh banks and at least m-t fresh economic coordinates. The specified player gets 3, the universal three-customer upper bound; repetition remains an invariant after all further deviations.
bank_proof_review.punish: The first BASE deviation to a fresh bank fixes that already-past bank as the permanent target. Before the terminal player, following a fresh pair gives 3 and the target is never moved to a later player. Reusing any bank enters valid EXIT. At the last node all banks have one prior user, and a fresh economic coordinate plus any bank gives the optimum 2.
bank_proof_review.base: An intermediate prescribed player gets 2+1/(m-1)>2. A nonprescribed fresh-bank deviation becomes the fixed PUNISH target and gets at most 1+1=2; a used-bank deviation also gets at most 2 and enters EXIT. These two cases exhaust every nonprescribed pair, including one-coordinate deviations. The last player gets the optimum 2. Every root pair gets exactly 1+1/(m-1), so root IC holds including ties.
bank_proof_review.welfare_and_optimum: The actual leaf ((0,0),(0,1),...,(0,m-2),(1,0)) covers two economics and every bank: W=2m. An m-tuple covers all economics and banks, hence OPT=3m-2. The m=2 middle segment is empty and valid.
bank_proof_review.fractional_background: For every real s>=0, all Cartesian pairings make arbitrary economic/bank marginals implementable. Uniform background gives Delta_m(s)<=m/(m+s)+2(m-1)/(m-1+s). Uniform-query Jensen, or simultaneous low-marginal coordinate pairing, gives the reverse bound for every free background. This is the true min_q max_A value, not a fixed background upper bound or an iid/integer value.
bank_proof_review.strict_failure_ranges: delta_m(0)>u1 for m>=3; delta_(m+1)(0)>u1 for m>=4; OPT/(2m)>u1 for m>=5. The proof covers every m in these ranges, not every SPE of the instance. Extra static competition s=m does not add a real player.
bank_proof_review.aggregate_limits: W-m delta_m(0)=m(m-1)/(2m-1)>0 and 2W-OPT=m+2>0. A fixed integer competitor profile gives v_m<=2 and W>=m v_m. No aggregate-security or half counterexample is inferred.
